commit_message: Complete persistent Scene View Timeline preview
pr_title: GameEngine: complete persistent Scene View Timeline preview
pr_body:
## Summary

- connect Sequencer scrub/play/pause/loop to the persistent Scene View preview world
- apply Timeline samples through the production engine composition adapter with stable authoring-to-runtime bindings
- restore authored transforms when a Property clip exits, playback stops, or Sequencer closes
- retain the Editor Scene View camera while production Camera Cut override state is evaluated
- add deterministic transport/runtime-adapter tests and a bound visual-validation fixture
- update ADR 0126 implementation status for the Scene View preview slice

## Validation

Run Windows Validation using the repository impact-based planner and Editor Visual Validation with the Sequencer scenario.
